chapter: Bird, the band's breakup and Luis Russell
title: Parker's triumph in New York and his unnoticed visit in 1939
summary: Dance and Ramey credit the McShann band and Parker for the Savoy impact; in 1939 Bird played New York for $6 a night and was ignored.
